text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Portuguese businessman Horacio Roque and Spanish tobacco company Tabacalera have told the Portuguese government they plan to invest in a factory in Macau.

- The Jorge de Mello/Philip Morris group bidding in the privatisation of tobacco company Tabaqueira has told the government that it would invest 7.7 billion escudos in the Albarraque cigarette factory north of Lisbon, according to the bid document.
- Leisure company Lusotur posted a loss of 435.8 million escudos in the first half of 1996 compared to a loss of 330.8 million escudos in the same year ago period.
- Prime Minister Antonio Guterres says Portugal will be one of the first group of countries to join the European single currency.
- Portugal Telecom (PT) plans to take part in the eventual privatisations of telecommunications companies in Angola and Mozambique, its president Murteira Nabo said.
